title: Cosmic Ember Bloom
description: A surreal central mass of glowing, multicolored orbs and fragments floats in a dark atmospheric space. The luminous cluster in warm oranges, reds, yellows and cool blues appears to be dissolving or materializing above a rocky, textured ground under a moody, cloudy night sky.
prompt: surreal dark fantasy painting of a large floating cluster of glowing multicolored luminous orbs and fragments in warm oranges reds yellows and cool blues, appearing to dissolve or materialize with particles floating around it, set against a moody cloudy night sky with dramatic atmosphere, textured rocky ground below, mysterious and ethereal lighting, painterly brushwork
